notes.title: Toribash 5.75
notes.content:
[h2][b]Toribash 5.75 is now available![/b][/h2]
This version features improvements to item effect fusion, better inventory search and several bug fixes.

[list][*][b]Item effect updates[/b]
You can now replace a fused item effect with a different one of the same type free of charge! All other applied effects will be kept as they are so you no longer need to completely purge all effects if you just want to swap a glow with a different color.

[*][b]Improved inventory search[/b]
Search has been updated to work better with multi word or partial queries.

[*][b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed bug with texture trails not properly reloading on customs updates during the session.
[*]Fixed bug with MoveMemory skipping steps when running the same move for multiple players at the same time.
[*]Fixed bug with MoveMemory potentially keeping some tooltips open when active moves end on the same turn.
[*]Fixed bug with oversaturated Toribash colors (Superior, Wisp, Mistral, etc) displaying incorrectly when used in chat.
[*]macOS: holding ⌘CMD key will no longer hide cursor and lock camera so that you can now use system-wide screenshot shortcuts more comfortably.
[*]macOS: fixed an issue preventing game chat and some input fields from pasting content with ⌘ + V shortcut.[/list][/list]

notes.title: Toribash 5.74
notes.content:
[h2][b]Toribash 5.74 is now available![/b][/h2]
[h3]This is a big content update featuring new Blind Fight mode, permanent challenge events and new (or old?) atmospheres.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/a48d267b12f77ccf012c78d311e68102b0ec5119.jpg[/img]

[list][*][h3][b]Blind Fight[/b][/h3]
Blind Fight is a new game mode where you need to create an opener which is then used to challenge other players' openers.
After submitting your first opener you will be placed in the Beginner League with up to 7 other players who just started playing Blind Fight. Stay at the top of the league by the time it resets (every 12 hours) or defeat everyone in one go and you will advance to the next league. Every time you move up a league, you will also be able to claim rewards which vary depending on your new league tier.
Once you reach Ultra league, you will be able to Prestige and start over with one of the three stats (strength, speed, endurance) lowered to climb leagues up and collect rewards once again.

We're launching Blind Fight with aikido.tbm as the base mod but it will change every month along with league resets in future.


[*][h3][b]Challenge Events[/b][/h3]
These are a collection of past event series (Opener Challenge, Floor is Lava, Free Run Frenzy) which will be permanently available in game from now on.
All of these events have been updated to use the latest events backend and some of them have been slightly modified (new checkpoint locations, adjusted objectives, etc) to provide a better challenge to players of all skill levels.
You will be able to replay these events and collect rewards even if you previously participated in them during the original runs.


[*][h3][b]Atmospheres[/b][/h3]
Atmos menu now features a remastered version of all [url="https://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=162608"]atmospheres originally created by Melmoth[/url].
In addition to that, there's also a new Chess Board atmosphere created by Szaszuniya which is the first atmo to adjust to dojo scale so that it looks good both no matter what mod you play.


[*][h3][b]Other changes[/b][/h3]
In addition to these 3 major updates, there are lots of other smaller changes featured in 5.74. Here are the most notable ones:

[list][*]Timelines support for [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/23B7-49AD-4A28-9590]Steam Game Recording[/url] feature.
[*]Added player 3 and player 4 focus camera modes with hotkeys being [b]8[/b] and [b]9[/b] respectively.
[*]Text fields in Toribash UI now have upgraded cursor position controls with an ability to move cursor with your mouse and support for more keyboard hotkeys.
[*]Fixed bug that was leading to cached replays desynchronising when loading in customs of players with hairs.
[*]Fixed bug that would sometimes trigger a crash when exiting Toribash.

[*]macOS: Toribash is now shipped with native binaries for Apple Silicon devices.
[*]macOS: error log will now appear under Log Reports in Console app with error file having been moved to the generic macOS directory [b][i]~/Library/Logs/com.nabistudios.Toribash[/i][/b].
[*]macOS: fixed bug that was leading to Toribash still generating BMP screenshots despite files having PNG extension.
[*]macOS: fixed bug with custom mod objects not loading properly when being located outside mod-specific assets folder.

[*]Lua: added new functions to control RPG state: [b]rpg_state()[/b], [b]get_rpg()[/b], [b]set_rpg()[/b] and [b]reset_rpg()[/b].
[*]Lua: added global [b]JSON[/b] class with [b]JSON.encode()[/b] and [b]JSON.decode()[/b] static methods.
[*]Lua: error output file will now instantly refresh on Lua errors.
[*]Lua: updated [b]Files.LogError()[/b] to write data to default error output file.[/list][/list]

notes.title: Sledge Ride
notes.content:
[h2]Introduction[/h2]
Hold tight to the handlebars and brace yourself for the ride of a lifetime!
In Sledge Ride, you'll navigate through a treacherous snowy landscape using your trusty Tori Sledge 6000.
Precision and control are key as you maneuver around snowy slopes, dodge obstacles, and aim for the finish line!
Will you glide gracefully or crash into a snowdrift? Only the most skilled riders will claim victory in this frosty showdown!

[h2]Rules[/h2]
[list][*]Replay hacking is forbidden
[*]Do not change any game rules
[*]Do not steal another players' replays
[*]Do not enter the event with multiple accounts[/list]
[h2]Prizes[/h2]
[h3]Pass the first checkpoint[/h3]
[list][*] 9000 Toricredits
[*] 2 Shiai Tokens
[*] 200 BP XP[/list]
[h3]Take to the skies[/h3]
[list][*] 4500 Toricredits
[*] 100 BP XP[/list]
[h3]Destroy a snowman[/h3]
[list][*] 4500 Toricredits
[*] 100 BP XP[/list]
[h3]Cross the finish line[/h3]
[list][*] 9000 Toricredits
[*] 1 Shiai Token
[*] Ski Goggles
[*] 200 BP XP[/list]

[h3]Hi, Toribash 5.71 is now available![/h3]
This release features a reworked Account menu, further improvements to replay keyframing and more!

[b]What's new:[/b]
[list][*][b]New Account menu[/b]
Account screen now comes with information on your Toribash purchases made with Steam Wallet, easier access to Login screen and account management on Toribash website.

[*][b]Replay keyframing QoL updates[/b]
With a new CTRL / ALT + K hotkey you can save replay keyframes with the default (1x) speed instead of current speed - or you can invert this behavior to save then with 1x speed by default with a new option in Settings (Game -> Replays). You can also now see keyframe's frame value by hovering over its icon in replay timeline for easier navigation.

[*][b]Bug fixes and other changes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed bug with dithering item effect not being displayed
[*]Fixed game crash when playing hacked replays that modify environment object's static flag
[*]Fixed bug with keyframe hint sometimes getting stuck after replay is over
[*]Fixed bug with mouse camera controls sometimes staying locked after using UI dropdowns
[*]Minor performance improvements for UI rendering[/list][/list]

notes.title: Toribash 5.70
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hi, Toribash 5.70 is now available![/b][/h3]
This major release features lots of modmaking updates, improves physics simulation accuracy and more!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mqjdhXZ.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]What's new in Toribash 5.70:[/b][/h3]

[list][*][h3][b]New mod features[/b][/h3]

[list][*]Increased total object count limit to 256
[*]Increased dynamic object count limit to 48
[*]Increased environment joint count limit to 24
[*]Static objects with non-zero hardness will now deal damage to player on collision
[*]Hardness parameter now affects dismembers / fractures
[*]Body / joint customizable bounce support
[*]Body / joint customizable friction support
[*]Customizable fracture support for joints
[/list]


[*][h3][b]Upgraded physics simulation[/b][/h3]
Beginning with 5.70, physics simulation will work slightly different compared to older game clients in all new games you play.
Remember how executing same moves as Tori and Uke would yield different outcomes in past? That's no longer going to happen.
The change is targeted at fixing the (historically broken) force damping in Toribash physics sim which will improve physics simulation accuracy.


[*][h3][b]Replay keyframing updates[/b][/h3]

[list][*]Keyframe display in replay timeline
[*]Edit existing keyframes by right-clicking them on timeline
[*]Replay speed support for keyframes
[*]Toggleable smoothing support for keyframes[/list]


[*][b]Other changes[/b]

[list][*]Ignoring a player will now also hide their emotes and shouts
[*]Fixed bug with hand / leg motion trail display when the wrist / ankle is dismembered
[*]Fixed bug with trigger score changes not affecting fight outcome
[*]Fixed crash when re-entering modmaker after exiting it while in replay mode
[*]Fixed camera smoothness on keyframed replays while at custom replay speed
[*]Fixed bug with replays saved in multiplayer getting players' names mixed up
[*]Various internal memory management optimizations
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Toribash 5.65 is now available!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi, it's update time![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/6c0f1943a2512299f6bc2a6035c0f9abf82d0bc3.png[/img]

[h3]Here's what's new in 5.65:[/h3]
[list][*]Max number of unique mod turn frames increased to 128
[*]Added proper support for opening mod / replay files with ToribashSP on macOS
[*]Added drag-and-drop support for mod and replay files
[*]UI dropdowns can now be quickly controlled with mouse scroll
[*]Updated offers display in Market
[*]Previous run's error log is now stored as [i]stderr-prev.txt[/i]
[*]Minor flame performance improvements
[*]Removed legacy flame browser
[*]Custom shader loading errors in mods and replays are no longer displayed in chat
[*]Fixed bug with classic.tbm gamerules resetting to default when they shouldn't (e.g. in replays)
[*]Fixed bug with potential unwanted gamerules updates triggered by game server (e.g. when changing turnframes or grip mode)
[*]Fixed bug with legacy replays (pre 3.6) potentially getting gravity set to 0 resulting in choppy playback
[*]Fixed bug with replays getting no author when saved during playback
[*]Fixed bug with chat tabs remaining visible after opening chat with [i]/opt hud 0[/i]
[*]Fixed bug with WASD camera controls sometimes not working after replay saving
[*]Fixed bug with UI popups getting overlayed by other UI elements in scrollable lists
[*]Fixed crash in modmaker when attempting to open it while having classic loaded and no modmaker.tbm file existing
[*]Fixed potential crash during Steam IAP finalization
[*]+ various minor UI tweaks and fixes[/list]

[b]New features available with Toribash Lua:[/b]
[list][*]set_flame_setting() now supports an additional argument to select target playerid.
In addition to that, you can specify -1 to set settings for Lua-managed flames (max 10 available).
[*]Added update_lua_flames() to trigger Lua managed flames physics update loop.
[*]Added load_flame_texture(string path, int flameid) to load a custom texture for one of Lua-managed flames.
[*]Added set_gameover(int gameover_type, int winnerid) to instantly end current game with the specified type.
[*]Added GAMEOVER_TYPE global table that contains available gameover types for the function above.
[*]Added Files.Exists(string path) method to [b]Files[/b] class to quickly check if file exists on user's device and is available for reading.[/list]

notes.title: Ranking
notes.content:
As times change, so does ranking!
universal mod rankings are back!


[h2]How it works[/h2]
All Green Belt+ players can participate and fight people to gain rank by playing ranked games in public lobbies + special ranked rooms.
You will be unranked for your first 5 games and placed in a rank according to your Elo based on how you played while unranked.
Ranking resets once a month with mod rankings never resetting and staying permanently. Make sure you never give up!


[h2]Rank tiers[/h2]
After playing your qualification matches, you will receive a rank tier depending on your Elo:

Elo Hell (0 - 1580)
Bronze (1580 - 1600)
Silver (1600 - 1620)
Gold (1620 - 1640)
Platinum (1640 - 1660)
Diamond (1660+)

notes.title: Toribash 5.60
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hi, Toribash 5.60 is now available![/b][/h2]
This release features major updates to Toribash scripting, brings lots of usability improvements and more!

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/mqjdhXZ.jpg[/img][/center]


[h2][b]What's new:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]New room list menu[/b][/h3]
The updated room list is better in every way, both having nicer looks and providing easy access to more information about rooms!
[expand type=details][img]https://i.imgur.com/cc1gNZp.png[/img][/expand]
It also has a much better "Create Room" menu that you can actually use now, isn't that amazing?
[expand type=details][img]https://i.imgur.com/BSahc4y.png[/img][/expand]
In addition to that, room list now shows several featured rooms with active players on top, more visibly separates official rooms from player-made ones, shows if the room is password protected so you don't have to guess and has more (and better working!) filters.


[h3][b]Lua replay hacking improvements & updated replay format[/b][/h3]
This one is for replaymakers - remember how you had to go around those weird bugs with Lua replay hacking working but also not always and then replays getting all glitchy and messed up and not nice at all?
This is no more! (unless you actually want to make your replay glitchy then sure you're welcome)

Along with a number of newly added Lua functions, with the help of [url=https://forum.toribash.com/member.php?u=4046519]Kris[/url] and [url=https://forum.toribash.com/member.php?u=6949762]Tom[/url] we've made replay hacking more straight forward with all your changes being properly stored in replay files, changes not getting randomly carried over to new fights and so on.

[expand type=details][img]https://i.imgur.com/Nr0PnjK.mp4[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Xftt2OX.mp4[/img][/expand]
If you're interested in writing Lua scripts for replay hacking, make sure you check the list of changes below!


[h3][b]Toribash Lua scripting updates[/b][/h3]
Majority of Toribash scripting classes now have annotations with EmmyLua which should vastly improve your coding experience if you're using a compatible editor.
[expand type=details][img]https://i.imgur.com/L0VjyOu.png[/img][/expand]
All built-in Toribash functions are now properly documented and listed in [i]system/system_defines.lua[/i] meta script which means you no longer need to wonder whether a function to do [i]something[/i] exists or not - you can always look it up there and make use of autocompletion in your IDE when using it in your code!

Get EmmyLua plugin for VS Code: [url]https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=sumneko.lua[/url]


[h3][b]More UI updates[/b][/h3]
More menus have received a facelift with 5.60, getting rounded corners and uniform design.
You'll notice the changes in moveable windows like Gamerules or MoveMemory, Replays menu and so on.
[expand type=details][img]https://i.imgur.com/aJKDI7k.png[/img][/expand]


[h3][b]Other changes[/b][/h3]
Below goes a list of other new features, tweaks and bug fixes included in Toribash 5.60

[list][*]News menu will now show notifications for unread news and events
[*]Windows version now saves screenshots as PNG instead of BMP for easier sharing
[*]Vastly improved 3D item loading performance
[*]Blood particles will now collide with static environments
[*]Collisions with static environment (e.g. walking on mod objects) will no longer generate blood particles by default
[*]Replay and replay folders now support non-latin characters in their names
[*]Added ability to invert camera axes in game settings
[*]Added lower quality fluid blood option in graphics settings
[*]Improved flame rendering performance
[*]Improved UI rendering performance

[*]Fixed bug with blood reflections not showing up
[*]Fixed bug with DQ ring always being rendered at 100% opacity
[*]Fixed bug with report post submission screen getting broken in some scenarios
[*]Fixed bug with Toribash Discord server link in report post submission screen being broken
[*]Fixed bug with camera getting stuck when looking up in freecam mode
[*]Fixed bug with replay speed getting stuck at 0 in some scenarious
[*]Fixed bug with special Toribash characters (!^%) not getting escaped in Login and Register screens
[*]Fixed bug with item effects not being rendered in UI viewports
[*]Fixed bug with Kiai sounds not playing on match start
[*]Fixed bug with mod triggers not working on instagib bodyparts and when grabbing env objects
[*]Fixed bug with menu resolution not updating after changing gui scale or game resolution[/list]


[b][h3]Toribash Lua scripting updates[/h3][/b]
In addition to replay hacking changes touched upon earlier, 5.60 introduces some other updates to Lua scripting:

[list][*][b]Raycasting[/b]
Say you want to create a clickable object in 3D world. What you'd probably do earlier is get the 2D position of object's coordinates and then do some manual calculations and guesswork on whether your click position is still within object bounds on screen - which is not always easy on rotated cubes or capsules.
What you can do with Lua raycasting is create a raycastable body and then shoot rays to it to test it instead! This is essentially the same functionality as what Toribash uses for detecting joint clicks, now available through scripting.

[*][b]System classes updates[/b]
Aside from getting EmmyLua annotations, majority of system classes have been majorly reworked, both to increase performance and match more modern scripts' code style.
While this means there are now new features to use in your scripts, some of old methods have been marked deprecated (and will be phased out in future Toribash releases) or had already been removed from public access.

One of the examples that we had come across during beta testing is that some third party scripts use TBMenu:displayTextField() method with manual setup instead of using the generic TBMenu:spawnTextField() method, which will throw an error in 5.60 as the former function has been moved to TBMenu internal helper class and is no longer exposed publicly. These issues, however, can be fixed pretty quickly in most cases, and migrating to the generic UI element spawner methods guarantees your scripts will be able to use any new features related to those elements in future automatically.

[*]New Lua functions added with 5.60
[expand type=details]
[*]set_obj_linear_vel()
[*]set_obj_angular_vel()
[*]get_joint_state_name()
[*]get_color_rgba()
[*]get_clipboard_text()
[*]generate_texture_gradient()
[*]create_raycast_body()
[*]set_raycast_body_pos()
[*]set_raycast_body_sides()
[*]set_raycast_body_rot()
[*]set_raycast_body_rot_m()
[*]destroy_raycast_body()
[*]shoot_ray()
[*]shoot_camera_ray()
[*]add_chat_history()
[*]generate_font()
[*]players_accept_input()
[*]get_body_bruise()
[*]get_joint_bruise()
[*]refresh_roomlist()
[*]get_roomlist_num_rooms()
[*]get_roomlist_room_info()
[*]get_obj_color()
[*]get_obj_shape()
[*]toggle_game_pause()
[*]is_game_paused()
[*]get_shader_option()
[*]set_shader_option()
[/expand]

[*]No longer available Lua functions
[expand type=details]
[*]download_ranking_toplist()
[*]download_ranking_trends()
[*]get_qi_reset_info()
[*]set_gameover_limit()
[*]draw_chat_input()
[*]get_num_blood_particles()
[*]set_decal()
[*]get_payment_mode()
[*]set_payment_mode()
[*]get_beginner()
[*]open_post_tutorial_menu()
[*]close_post_tutorial_menu()
[*]set_post_tutorial_alpha()
[*]market_call()
[*]move_replay()
[*]sopen_replay()
[*]end_tutorial()
[*]open_upmenu()
[/expand][/list]

notes.title: Toribash 5.60 alpha
notes.content:
[h3]This is the first public alpha version of the next major Toribash 5.60 update[/h3]
[i]This alpha is primarily targeted at scripters and replaymakers to give a heads-up on what's to come as it introduces some breaking changes to some Toribash Lua functionality and the new replay data protocol.
To switch to this build, choose "alpha" in the Betas tab in Toribash properties from your Steam Library.[/i]


[h3][b]What's new in Toribash 5.60:[/b][/h3]
[b]Lua replay manipulation updates[/b]
All player or environment changes (position, rotation, velocity, etc) triggered with Lua are now properly stored in replay files. See the list of all new functions below.


[b]Documentation with EmmyLua annotations[/b]
We know Toribash has been notorious for its lack of documentation when it comes to game-specific Lua functionality. With 5.60 we're adding documentation for all existing Toribash functions as well as for built-in classes like UIElement or PlayerInfo.
EmmyLua is available as an extension for VSCode or IntelliJ IDEA.

Current alpha version does not have the final documentation yet and will receive further updates closer to stable release.


[b]Texture atlas support[/b]
You can now load a single master texture and render its specific parts. This will be especially useful if you need to draw [i]a lot[/i] of textures which will normally get capped by max texture limit.


[b]All Lua hooks are now executed in a predetermined order[/b]
In past, when you attach multiple callbacks to the same Lua event you couldn't predict which order they'll be executed in. This has been revised in 5.60 and now hooks will always execute in the same order as they've been added.


[b]Raycasting functionality in Lua[/b]
You can now create raycastable bodies and shoot rays with Lua. That [b]is[/b] cool.
Lua bodies will exist in their own space and will not collide with any other objects.


[b]Other updates[/b]
[list][*]Screenshots are now saved as PNG files instead of BMP
[*]Vastly improved obj loading performance
[*]utf8 library support for Lua
[*]Blood particles now collide with static environment
[*]Blood particles no longer get generated from player collisions with static environment by default (requires hardness > 0)
[*]New UITween class (toriui/uitween.lua) that can be used for time-accurate animations[/list]

[b]List of all new Lua functions:[/b]
[expand type=showmore][code]set_obj_linear_vel()
set_obj_angular_vel()
get_joint_state_name()
get_color_rgba()
get_clipboard_text()
generate_texture_gradient()
create_raycast_body()

shoot_ray()

generate_font()
players_accept_input()
get_body_bruise()
get_joint_bruise()[/code][/expand]

[b]List of all deprecated Lua functions:[/b]
[expand type=showmore][code]download_ranking_toplist()

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/6fae796ce824421f3800b93dd275aac01285dec0.png[/img]

[h1]How it works[/h1]

We are incredibly excited to announce to you our brand new, improved and hopefully better BATTLEPASS!

The Battlepass is a way you can earn rewards just from playing the game. Various aspects of the game grant you xp towards the Battlepass such as ranked(coming next month!), tournaments, quests and even just playing with your friends normally. As you gain XP you gain levels along with it, as you hit these levels you unlock rewards at every tier.
We have two versions of the Battlepass, a free version and a premium version which costs $10. Purchasing the premium Battlepass allows you to gain both sets of rewards.

Battle Pass prizes include Toricredits, Shiai Tokens, Boosters, Flames, Color and 3D items as well as unique BP-specific new items!

[h1]Premium[/h1]

You can purchase a Premium version of Battle Pass to receive even better rewards, including a limited edition color.
Press the "Upgrade to Premium" button on the Battle Pass screen and you will be able to claim 3X more Toricredits, 2X more Shiai Tokens and more!

If grinding isn't your thing, it is possible to purchase levels throughout the Battlepass using Shiai Tokens, too.

This battlepass(es) will last for a month each, they've been adjusted from the last battlepass and made easier to complete.

notes.title: Snow Slinging Showdown
notes.content:
[h3]Hello and welcome to Snow Slinging Showdown!![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/f273a65c44abd60eb901c64ef9bff9f7eeb78a35.png[/img]

Event Squad gets you into the holidays with a festive fresh event. Join us this winter for some [b]HARD HITTING[/b] snowball action alongside a powerhouse of other events we've been cooking up!

We've kept this simple, but we haven't fallen short in making this challenging. You will be given an arsenal of snowballs which you'll have to sling at different targets to achieve the different milestones for rewards. There are 3 snowmen at varying distances, each giving you an opportunity to win different prizes. Simple enough? Show us.

And as usual, the best replay of the event will claim the grand reward!

[h3]Prizes[/h3]

[b]Beginner Tier[/b]
Pick up a snowball and YEET that into the closest snowman.
[b]Reward:[/b]
[list]
[*] 4,500 TC
[*] 2 ST
[/list]

[b]Intermediate Tier[/b]
Pick up a snowball and hit the middle snowman in the body (not the legs!).
[b]Reward:[/b]
[list]
[*] 7,500 TC
[*] 3 ST
[/list]

[b]Advanced Tier[/b]
If you've made it this far, lets see you push yourself farther. There's one obscure dwindling snowman really far off. See it? This one's tricky, the last and farthest snowman moves.
Now, aim for its head!.
[b]Reward:[/b]
[list]
[*] 12,500 TC
[*] 5 ST
[/list]

[b]Best Replay[/b]
Is your replay the best show of snowball mastery and skill? If yes, then this reward is yours!
[list][*]125,000 Toricredits
[*]10 Shiai Tokens[/list]

notes.title: Christmas 2022
notes.content:
[h2]MERRY CHRISTMAS FROM THE TORIBASH STAFF![/h2]

Hello Toribash Gamers, welcome to our Christmas celebration! What other way to celebrate a holiday other than taking part in some events brought to you by the one and only Event Squad!

Keep an eye out for the events, there'll be plenty! From art-related events, to client events that will for sure keep you busy!

This year is filled with unique events, with prizes that will definitely get you excited!
It's the season of giving, so we will be giving out some awesome rewards!
Not even Santa could have arranged such fun, and he had the whole year!


Aside from the client event called "Santa's Helper" we also prepared:

[h3][b]Tori Santa 2022[/b][/h3]

[url=https://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=658333]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WzUJOUE.png[/img][/url]

[url="https://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=658333"]Click here to see the event![/url]!

By simply posting in the thread your name will be put into the Tori Santa list, where we later scramble them around and pick you a random person you'll be sending a gift to! Don't worry, you'll be someone's Tori Santa as well. This event is all about spreading the holiday cheer within our community!

Who knows, maybe your Tori Santa will give you hundreds of items!


[h3][b]Too Many Artists Spoil The Tori: Christmas Craze![/b][/h3]

[url=https://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=658335]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bFVJoDr.png[/img][/url]

[url="https://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=658335"]Click here to see the event![/url]!

In this event every participant will get a specific body part texture and will do their best to create some festive texture! The catch is that once the deadline is over we'll be compiling all the textures made into one huge set! Who knows, maybe too many artists actually spoil the tori, or maybe we'll create a masterpiece!

Every participant will get 2 Shiai Tokens and a 512x512 texture of their assigned body part upon completion! You don't want to miss out on an amazing chance to get awesome textures!

[b]And there will be one more event! We'll be announcing it soon![/b]

We're adding back our seasonal Christmas items too!
Celebrate Christmas with your tori!

What are you waiting for? You can find them all in the [url="https://forum.toribash.com/tori_shop.php?cid=78"]Torishop[/url]!


We've also made 

THE GIFTING SPIRIT!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/35d514694eb3e2719698ac400fd8d4368fa3276c.png[/img]

You can purchase The Gifting Spirits for 5,000 TC or 1ST each in the Torishop, available only during Christmas, so hurry up! Or you can click the following images to redirect to the specific items:

[url="https://forum.toribash.com/tori_shop_item.php?id=3852"][img]https://cache.toribash.com/forum/torishop/images/items/giftspiritl.png[/img][/url][url="https://forum.toribash.com/tori_shop_item.php?id=3853"][img]https://cache.toribash.com/forum/torishop/images/items/giftspiritr.png[/img][/url]

All of the festive items will be available in the Torishop until the 7th of January!

notes.title: Toribash 5.55
notes.content:
[h2]Toribash 5.55 is now available![/h2]
[b]This update features Season 8 with Battle Pass and a bunch of other improvements and tweaks.[/b]


[h3]What's new in Toribash 5.55:[/h3]

[list][*][b]Battle Pass[/b]
Toribash Season 8 comes with Battle Pass and 5.55 features the new GUI to help you view your season and BP progress, quests and claim rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/9c0743a8c752f2dc7014438d02400029ae08c50e.png[/img]
Learn more about Toribash Season 8 and Battle Pass: [url=https://toribash.com/season8]https://toribash.com/season8[/url]


[*][b]Quests[/b]
Quests screen has received a complete overhaul and is now easier to use, provides more information and supports new quest types \o/
[expand type=details][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/440e892387ae3526e8f93a75f4aa1929fce9c135.png[/img][/expand]
New quests that you'll notice when completing Battle Pass and with future events:
[list][*]Bounty related quests
[*]Requirements to win games by points or disqualification
[*]Market related quests[/list]


[*][b]Bounties[/b]
Old players may remember bounty text working differently in the past - it would be added to your account [i]after[/i] the bounty is claimed instead of only being shown while it's active.
Well, now we have both!
"After claim" bounty text can be set for the additional 2000 TC and is a great way to customize your profile with an extra caption or annoy your friends with some silly text that they'd have to live with :)


[*][b]Scripting[/b]
Starting with 5.55, all new functionality will have EmmyLua-powered annotations for easier code understanding and documentation purposes. You can get it as a VS Code plugin: [url]https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=sumneko.lua[/url]
[list][*]Texture resolution is no longer required to have power-of-two sides
[*]draw_quad() has been extended to support texture tinting
New usage: [code]draw_quad(number pos_x, number pos_y, number width, number height[, integer texture_id, integer patterned, number r, number g, number b, number a])[/code][/list]

[b]UIElement updates:[/b]
[list][*]Patterned and recolorable image support for UIElements
[*]UIElement imageHoverColor and imagePressedColor fields to use for image transition animations
[*]Horizontal scrollable lists support for UIElements
[*]UIElement mouse hooks are now initialized by default and no longer need to be defined manually by scripts
[*]Support for different radius values for the top and bottom side of rounded UIElements
[*]Shorthand functions for adding single mouse handlers: addMouseDownHandler(), addMouseUpHandler(), addMouseMoveHandler(), addMouseUpRightHandler()
[*]Table-related functions defined in uielement.lua are now a part of _G.table
[*]table.qsort() fix to support string with number/boolean comparison
[*]String-related functions defined in uielement.lua are now a part of _G.string
[*]Guid() function is now named generate_uid()
[*]debugEcho() function is now named print_r()
[*]Global variables defined in menu_manager.lua are now TBMenu fields
[*]Draw call performance improvements for rounded UIElements
[*]Major performance improvement for scrollable lists when controlled with a UI bar
[/list]


[*][b]Other changes[/b]
[list][*]Notifications now support scrolling through the long messages and have a tidied up look
[*]Ability to delete private messages from Notifications menu
[*]Better UX for Steam Wallet microtransactions
[*]Fixed starting camera position on large mods to stick to active player by default
[*]Standalone client will now remember the Toribash path and use it to update data files when installing a new version next time
[*]Standalone client and admin-run Steam client now register a handler for toribash://connect%20room links to launch the game and join a room
[*]Added new flags
[*]Ability to enable exhibition mode (/opt exhibition 1) that will auto-cycle replays in active folder until you start a new game
[*]Ability to disable auto tourney broadcasts but keep showing other global messages (Settings -> Game)
[*]Fixed bug with default player3 and player4 being sometimes displayed shortly after game launch
[*]Fixed potential Lua drawing issues when using negative values for size in draw_quad() and draw_disk() calls
[*]Fixed bug with post-game earned TC/Qi info being shown incorrectly
[*]Added support for chat scrolling with numpad
[/list][/list]

notes.title: Toribash 5.53
notes.content:

[list][*][b]In-game Market[/b]
Game market uses the same foundation as [url=https://forum.toribash.com/marketplace.php]Marketplace[/url] on Toribash website- this means you can trade items with other players, get stuff for a lower price than in game store and potentially even buy exclusive items you wouldn't be able to purchase otherwise!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/0b1f6937c96ce0830551ee570c8ca5b07ccd4f3c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/184e06e280d9adef782eb8699a725852fe9ad9df.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/ae0de5f43c3c7952ea66a5b556c524c47aad39a3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/d95dfc845124bc2281d8caca5ee7b69641554730.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/45ad88846febfff14f509f0eff3648775c221cac.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/0b4382799fed6ff3df51969764c4eafd6099af1b.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/047e22117f0b564046d7788d449fcbd381c89dfe.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/2e17922c2026048bd7beb4d22aad3c01477bc2b7.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/b7efa685f91e2361a61fb7ceafb696a48b28ed88.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/12e7035d390207ce0e23716f33e7c1b3f9fe36c7.png[/img][/url]

Aside from basic trading, new market also allows you to quickly see your general stats in order to fully enjoy your [b]PROFIT[/b] and set up shops with custom names with descriptions for a more personal feel!

For more information about Toribash market, see [url=https://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=651760]Marketplace release thread[/url] on Toribash forums.


[*][b]3 and 4 player support in Free Play[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/fb530100b0418de31b012dcf64cba9ba7582be40.png[/img]
Boot up any mod, open gamerules menu (CTRL + G), change num players to 3 or 4 and boom, it just works!
Huge thanks to [url=https://forum.toribash.com/member.php?u=4236375]Crollex[/url] and [url=https://forum.toribash.com/member.php?u=7044285]Accelerator[/url] for making male and female versions of new characters' head textures that look absolutely amazing.


[*][b]Other updates[/b]
[list][*]Account tab has been removed from main menu's navigation bar and is now accessible by clicking "Account" tab in top right bar
[*]Added customizable GUI scaling (accessible from Graphics tab in Settings)
[*]Added folder choice dropdown in replay save menu as per [url="https://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=651640"]Shogunna's suggestion[/url]
[*]Added customizable opacity for replacement joint 3D items
[*]Inventory data is now cached to improve load speed on big inventories
[*]Added information title on system confirmation boxes (buying item, unlocking pack etc)
[*]Game will now load a random replay from one of default folders on startup
[*]Pressing F to save replay will no longer display temporary replay file name as current fight name
[*]Re-saving an active replay will no longer modify replay players
[*]Game now uses default system cursor to make sure it's reasonably scaled
[*]Changed pre_draw lua hook behavior to work in any game mode
[*]Reduced comic effects display duration by 33%
[*]Lua UIElement input fields now properly handle Caps Lock
[*]Improved Lua UIElement text drawing performance
[*]Added rounded corners on main GUI elements
[*]Added new graphical assets[/list]


[*][b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed bug with file browser not opening on Windows
[*]Fixed -1 notifications bug
[*]Fixed bug with resolution being too high when current screen resolution is lower than max supported
[*]Fixed some possible replay cache generator crashes and made it keep more stable fps while working
[*]Fixed bug with spectator info dropdown always showing roles for the first spectator
[*]Fixed bug with quests data not updating while in multiplayer
[*]Fixed bug with confirmation screen's buttons sometimes getting cut on sides due to being too wide
[*]Fixed bug with replays with capitalized symbols in filename not opening on Linux[/list][/list]

notes.title: Toribash 5.53 alpha
notes.content:
Toribash 5.53 alpha is now available on alpha branch on Steam for Windows machines.
To try it out, go to Toribash properties from your Steam Library, open Betas tab and switch to "alpha" branch.

Toribash 5.53 has the new Market support, bug fixes and some other minor updates.

[list][*][b]Market[/b]
In-game Market features much the same functionality as the web version of [url=https://forum.toribash.com/marketplace.php]Marketplace[/url].
You can put your items on sale or submit purchase requests, view shops and so on.
[url=https://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=651760]More info about Marketplace in News[/url]

[list][*]Inventory is now automatically downloaded on startup so you should no longer need to wait until it refreshes the first time you open Inventory or Market.
[i]Opening those instantly after starting the game before files have finished loading would still cause status errors / loading screens.[/i]
[*]Inventory data is now cached in memory after first load which should boost loading speed on huge inventories / machines with slow disk.
[*]Account tab has been removed from main menu, Account menu can now be accessed by pressing a button next to username on top right
[*]Added information title on system confirmation boxes (buying item, unlocking pack etc)
[*]Game will now load a random replay from one of default folders on startup
[*]-1 notifications bug shouldn't be occuring anymore
[*]Fixed bug with file browser not opening
[*]Fixed bug with resolution being too high when current screen resolution is lower than max supported
[*]Added rounded corners on main GUI elements
[*]Added new graphical assets[/list][/list]

notes.title: Toribash 5.52
notes.content:
[h3]Toribash 5.52 is now available on Steam![/h3]
[b]This update features item effects, better in-game inventory, improved speed for file downloads and customs loading, bug fixes and other minor improvements.[/b]
[list]
[*][h3]Item Effects[/h3]
[b]Item effects are a new type of customization for your Tori which can be fused into your Force, Relax, Primary Gradient and Head Texture items.[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/026bf0b48257cd4f73db5153ab586aa07e9c83cf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/257b002a62d0b2be69741848b41190fd51018cdd.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/61d3f759ccdc7a6feeac296b6a5ba85a7c9a6d97.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/ea57840728a28946f9f5772f11455c6b804d8fbe.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/18a59ab7b3772ceeab478c9d58cc6f5fd5d4fc4b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/3b663e934bfeb42646dd7f8a54493752a7c919c7.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/fa02fc73ff75b3f94c9958260817b7d9dc28d0e2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/cfeb7c1e25602d22961f17d16a8e846e188cc0dd.png[/img][/url]

[b]To apply an effect to your items, you need to fuse them together.[/b]
Upon fusion, effect item is destroyed and its effect is permanently applied to the item you've chosen.
You can stack effects of different type and apply all of them to the same item. First fusion into an item is free, every subsequent fusion costs 50,000 TC multiplied by number of effects already fused into the item.

[b]When fused with an item, some effects offer additional upgrades (glow intensity for glows, pixel size for dithering).[/b]
These become available for free once you play the required number of fights with the item equipped or can be purchased at any moment with Shiai Tokens.


[*][h3]Improved in-game inventory[/h3]
[b]Inventory received a proper "Customize" view for texture items, items that allow effect fusion and upgradeable items - so you can manage them right from the game without visiting forums.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/cf1c69b44d2b1113e59a15cf085bc6b0c88a4a12.png[/img]

Your owned texture items will also now have the uploaded texture displayed instead of default item icon (requires caching it first by opening Customize screen).

Inventory also received some general backend improvements to increase overall stability and QoL changes such as double-clicking on a set to view its contents and remembering last viewed page and list position when reentering Inventory after leaving it.

[*][h3]Other updates[/h3]
[list][*]Set number of players (1 or 2) for any mod via gamerules menu or /set numplayers command when in Free Play.
[*]Linux version is now 64-bit.
[*]Improved GUI scaling on low resolutions.
[*]Added Tori Twerk atmosphere by Tomato.

[*]Fixed bug that was preventing folders from being shown in various menus with opt filesort 0.
[*]Fixed bug with timer / frames display ordering introduced in Toribash 5.5.
[*]Fixed purchase confirmation boxes' text overlapping.
[*]Fixed bug with TC not always refreshing properly after redownloading customs.
[*]Fixed bug that lead to corrupted replays when editing it after frames run out without pressing R.
[*]Fixed bug in Linux version that was preventing files from being downloaded properly.
[*]Fixed bug in Linux version that was preventing sounds from playing.

[*]Lua scripting updates:[list][*]Max texture limit has been raised to 384.
[*]Added BitOp support for bitwise operations.
[*]Updated get_color_info() with game_name field to get the color's game name.
[*]Added set_draw_effect() to use for all 3d draw functions[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Toribash 5.5
notes.content:
Hi, Toribash 5.5 is now out of beta and available for everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/fd342e99819eaf64a88dadb36925a24dc2274653.png[/img]

[b]What is new in Toribash 5.5:[/b]


[list][*][b]New type of grabs - rotatable and can be broken[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/130d3528be8ad83d46b47e41a6260b1388dfb042.gif[/img]
[i]Grip mode can be changed via gamerules menu (CTRL + G). Manual commands are /set grabmode and /set tearthreshold.[/i]
[list][*]New grabs allow rotating whatever you're grabbing compared to fixed default grabs
[*]Tear threshold is used to determine how much force is required to break the grab (0 is disabled)
[*]Grab breaking depends on force direction - it's easier to break a grab when you're pulling something away and almost impossible when pushing[/list]

[*][b]Advanced ghost with customizable speed and length[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/38f21fed7c3189e49c975a5e2aa6cf5e88e33600.gif[/img]
[i]Ghost settings can be modified in gamerules menu. Manual commands are /set ghostspeed and /set ghostlength. To revert back to default ghost, use /set ghostcustom 0.[/i]
[list][*]Ghost speed can be set from 0.1x to 5x
[*]Ghost length can be set from 10 to 500 frames[/list]

[b]Using new grabs or ghosts in multiplayer will make the room unavailable for players on older versions of Toribash.[/b]




[*][b]New gamerules menu[/b]
[list][*]Only relevant settings are displayed (e.g. grab mode is only displayed when grabs toggle is checked)
[*]Some setting names have been updated to be easier to understand
[*]Settings that only allow specific values are now displayed as dropdowns or sliders[/list]


[*][b]New flame forger (CTRL + L)[/b]
[list][*]Preview up to 5 flames at once
[*]General flame forging prices have been lowered and now depend on more flame parameters (meaning simple flames will be even cheaper)
[*]New "relative gravity" setting to apply gravity relatively to bodypart your flame is linked to
[*]If you already have flames equipped, they'll be initially loaded in forger with proper settings
[*]Ability to forge flames directly from game client
[*]Ability to save flames for future spawning
[*]Ability to minimize flame forger without unloading flames (ctrl + shift + L)[/list]


[*][b]New flame browser (access via flame forger)[/b]
[list][*]View any existing flame by its ID
[*]View general info about the flame - who and when forged it, how much did it cost, who currently owns it
[*]Search for flames by their name / forger / current owner[/list]


[*][b]Other minor updates[/b]
[list][*]Multi-key search in replays menu
[*]Updated visuals on error messages
[*]New "/set curtf" command to modify current fight's turn frames while in single player
[*]High DPI mode for Apple devices (requires Retina screen) - can be toggled from Graphics tab in Settings
[*]Minimum screen resolution has been increased to 768x480
[*]Allow loading mods without specifying .tbm at the end
[*]Downloads should now be faster[/list]


[*][b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed win points not counting damage dealt from dismembers or fractures
[*]Fixed damage threshold not scaling on heavy hits
[*]Fixed joint position sometimes being displayed at a wrong position when it's linked to a rotated bodypart
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause crashes when loading a mod with a motd[/list][/list]


[h3][b]Merry Christmas and happy 'bashing![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Head Texture of the Month: Finish It!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/c6fd4e9484fa24da904330e83dab068946a9c78c.png[/img]

[h3]Head Texture of the Month is back for October, and yet again, with another special twist![/h3]
We took some inspiration from [url=https://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=503607]Calamity's Finish It Challenge![/url] to bring you an event that will get those creative juices flowing.
You will have until November 8th to create a head texture, and as there is no set style other than the provided sketch, you'll have full artistic freedom yet again!
The person who creates the head that best fits the judging criteria receives prizes, but don't worry, if you don't make it out on top there will be several honorable mentions. Now lets get to drawing everyone!

[h2]Rules[/h2]
We do still have rules that are to be followed. Keep in mind we may not judge your art if it doesn't follow ALL of these rules.

[list][*] You are required to use the sketch provided at the bottom of this announcement.
[*] You must use ALL of the sketch, but you're allowed to break up the lines that are not separated as well if needed.
[*] You must show proof that you used and kept the original line-work provided. (Ex. Drawing over them with a visible color.)
[*] You are allowed to mirror the line-work, but you're only required to show the original line-work.
[*] No plagiarism, this isn't tolerated at all and is severely punishable.
[*] Do not submit old or premade textures.
[*] A rough sketch or WIP is required to prove that it is a head in progress and not a premade head that you are reposting.
[*] Collaborations are allowed, however in this scenario prizes will be split.
[*] Only one submission is allowed, which also means no alts used to submit two different heads. If you're collaborating with another artist, you can only submit that head.
[*] Submissions must be in 512x512 resolution or higher.
[*] Post watermarked flats in event thread with spherical previews. It would be much appreciated if you used [url=https://www.toribashtextures.com]Toribash Textures[/url] for 3D previews.
[*] If you aren't using Toribash Textures, ensure to make your previews clear, show all aspects of your head and attempt to keep watermarks somewhat non-intrusive while still being effective.[/list]


[h2]Prizes[/h2]
[b]The winner will receive the following:[/b]
[list][*]2048x1024 Head Texture item
[*]7 Shiai Tokens
[*]75,000 Toricredits[/list]

The winners of the honourable mentions prize will receive the following:
[list][*]512x512 Head Texture item
[*]3 Shiai Tokens
[*]25,000 Toricredits[/list]


[h2][url=https://cache.toribash.com/events/images/HTOTM-FinishIt-Linework.png]Click here to download the sketch[/url][/h2]
[url=https://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=644291]Event thread on Toribash Forums[/url]

notes.title: Toribash 5.44 - August Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hi![/h1]
[b]This update is mainly focused on remastering the Bounty system, realtime ghosts and bug fixes to the Toribash 5.44[/b]

[h3][b]Bounty updates[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/42e6403bc371fb7b677b6fa5f1833c6ee39c8f9b.png[/img]
[b]You can now view the list of active bounties, add bounties on your friends and see your global bounty stats![/b]

In addition to game client updates, we've done several updates to the game servers that were pushed live earlier previous Friday:
[list][*] Getting a win streak of 5 (on at least 3 different players) will automatically trigger a 500 TC bounty on your head
[*] Every fight you win in a public room with an active bounty will make you win a portion of it - you essentially get a TC booster!
[*] Joining a room with a bounty on will notify everyone inside that you're being hunted[/list]

We've also removed the old 2000 TC fee on adding bounties, woohoo!


[h3][b]Realtime ghost updates[/b][/h3]

In short, we've made it possible to see realtime ghosts not only for spectators, but also for players currently fighting. We're also going to enable realtime ghosts in most public rooms later this week for everyone to try it out, so get ready to mind games with your opponents!

[b]To try realtime ghosts in your own rooms, use /realtimeghost command.[/b]



[url=https://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=642059]Read the full list of updates in this version on Toribash forums[/url]

notes.title: Toribash 5.44

[h2]Hi, Toribash 5.44 is now publicly available![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/5b5cf5675c213732ebf3d93d81e2e69b181d2836.png[/img]

[b]What's new in Toribash 5.44:[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Notifications[/b]
Your forums PMs can now be viewed directly in game client. No more checking forums to see whether you've got TC from other players or what item you've won in an event!

[*][b]Global Quests[/b]
Global quests allow you to get rewards for hitting certain gameplay milestones, be it gaining a new belt, inviting friends to Toribash, winning games in certain mods and so on. Global quests are available in the Quests tab.

[*][b]New login and register screen[/b]
Both screens got the new look - and it's not just the looks but we've also added the referral system to the registration. You can now invite your friends to Toribash, have them specify your name during registration, and once they hit 100 Qi you both will be able to get free stuff!

[*][b]General menu optimizations[/b]
Main menu should load up quicker now, and generally work slightly better.

[*][b]Various bug fixes[/b]
[/list]

With Toribash 5.44 we've also dropped support for 32-bit macOS systems and will now only release the 64-bit version of the game.
Windows and Linux will stay 32 bit for now, but that may change with any future updates.


Have fun fighting!

notes.title: Toribash Movember
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/a62abe5779ca9935d7e757a6dd8b242a3d5cf997.png[/img]

[b][h1]Hi and welcome to Toribash Movember![/h1][/b]
[b]This November, it's time to put on your manliest stache![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/9c9cc32e81fa21fe799cc1c0f51cf5b6e11e7ca6.png[/img]
[b]Toribash Movember is a free-for-all global event.[/b]
To participate, all you need to do is open the Movember event interface from the News tab in your game client.
Right after that, you will receive your free upgradeable Moustache item - and your task will be to upgrade it as far as you can.
Those of you who reach max 'stache level will receive the grand prize - limited edition [b]Krakenstache[/b] item!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/9212a649e1f4bf33291d038988e226d44376a8b7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/d3ddcdc580f2e934083d1dad770be4b65be60d2a.png[/img]
There are multiple ways to gain points to upgrade your Moustache:
[list][*]Playing online games (1 point per fight)
[*]Completing quests (20 points per quest, up to 3 per day)
[*]Claiming daily login rewards (up to 75 points for 7th day of consecutive logins)
[*]Winning bets (minimum 4 players have to place the bet, up to 5 points per won bet)
[*]Winning automatic tournaments (50 points per tourney)
[*]Winning ES events (100 points per event)[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/b887d6912fdf52ef5649759df32e15b556493938.png[/img]
Upgrading your Moustache item to max level during the event will unlock a [b]unique Krakenstache[/b] item for you, which won't be ever available in the shop after the event ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/f7b4961464a4cdde62744e4b087ad8e2b41efc95.jpg[/img]


[b]See more about Toribash Movember and discuss the event on Toribash forums: [url=https://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=633220]https://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=633220[/url][/b]

notes.title: Toribash 5.43
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hi, Toribash 5.43 is now available![/b][/h1]

[b]Updates in this release:[/b]
[list][*][b]New queue list dropdowns and ingame reports[/b]
Right-clicking on players' names now brings up a new dropdown menu which shows basic user info and relevant control buttons.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6036085/e04f0f4429e771926a6e19b2841400f4a63063ad.png[/img]
You can also now report users using a built-in report tool: choose report reason, add more info if necessary and submit it for staff to deal with.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6036085/3e7c52f8832e57408a6fe1ace2887bf43ec251e1.png[/img]

[*][b]Inventory update[/b]
Inventory received both a visual and a functional update.
Your items are now displayed as a scrollable list (similar to forum inventory view), which makes more item information instantly accessible. You can also now upgrade your multi-level 3D items right from game client inventory, as well as see their current level.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6036085/bf6c0042d1fdd1835cd9b6c5e3cc611b9e907c54.png[/img]

[*][b]Store vanilla item previews[/b]
Store now supports old style item previews. To enter old preview mode, press the "Preview" button on items that support it.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6036085/71f3a137a98e9cb0600124d1c011f9fbafaa5234.png[/img]

[*][b]New events[/b]
5.43 also includes backend updates for new automated events.
First one, Free Run Frenzy, is already live - it's out first automated parkour event.

[*][b]Other updates[/b]
- Pure, Supernova, Toxic, Mana, Meteor, Sakura and similar gradient colors now have same brightness level as joint colors instead of being pale and dull.
- Autosave replays folder is now sorted by replay date instead of filename.
- Lots of misc fixes[/list]

[h1][b]Hi![/b][/h1]

notes.title: Ranking Season 6
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6036085/e598e026b1b96cac61d5f66a713210d7e1b6d72a.png[/img]

[h1][b]Toribash Ranking is back with Season 6![/b][/h1]
[b]Defeat other players in ranked mode, climb ranks and get exclusive rewards![/b]


[h1]About Toribash Ranking[/h1]
All Brown Belt+ players can participate in Season 6 by playing ranked games in special ranked rooms or via ranked matchmaking.
Your first 10 ranked games' outcome will be used to put you in your starting rank tier. Toribash ranking uses Elo system as its base, so with every fight you win you gain some Elo points based on your opponent's rank (and vice versa). The more Elo points you have, the better rank you get.


[h1]Rank Tiers[/h1]
After playing qualification matches, you will receive a rank tier depending on your Elo:
[list][*]Elo Hell (0 - 1550)
[*]Bronze (1550 - 1575)
[*]Silver (1575 - 1595)
[*]Gold III (1595 - 1615)
[*]Gold II (1615 - 1630)
[*]Gold I (1630 - 1645)
[*]Platinum III (1645 - 1660)
[*]Platinum II (1660 - 1675)
[*]Platinum I (1675 - 1690)
[*]Diamond (1690+)[/list]


[h1]Ranked Quests[/h1]
Aside from classic end-of-season rewards, this time you will be able to get additional rewards throughout the whole season by completing ranked quests, which will feature Season 6 exclusive color items and brand new 3D items! Number of quests you can get isn't limited, so the more you play the more items you can get as rewards!


[b]Learn more about Season 6 in Toribash main menu's Ranked tab or on forums: https://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=627137[/b]

3D items connected to joints used to utilize bodypart positions which lead to them moving incorrectly when in motion. It's been changed with this update, so now they'll keep the correct position all the time (note: we'll update existing 3D joint items to work according to new standards within a few days - if you own any of those items and notice they got messed up, don't freak out).

[/list]

notes.title: Season 5
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hi![/b][/h1]
[h1][b]Season 5 has started, time to abandon your studies and play Toribash![/b][/h1]
(that was a joke please don't drop out of school kids)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6036085/2593b00c30529091f938946cc81627bbb2f4a741.png[/img]

[h1]Description[/h1]
Toribash Ranking is based on a seasonal system.
There are three seasons per year, each 3 months long. Best players of each year's seasons will compete in Toribash World Championships for the title of the best player of the year.
At the end of each season, players who qualified for Silver Tier or higher receive unique prizes.
The higher you ranked during the season, the better prizes you'll receive - starting with mid-tier body colors and up to Elite Tier color packs with unique full body customization sets.

[h1]How to play[/h1]
To qualify for a rank tier during a season, you need to play at least 10 ranked games.
Main way to earn rank is to play in Ranked Matchmaking mode. Additionally, there will be two public Ranked servers available for players below Platinum Tier until December. What's more, by winning ranked fights you not only climb up ranks but also earn additional XP for your clan!

[h1]The new Toribash 5.33 Matchmake UI[/h1]
We've reworked the "Matchmaking" menu tab to show more of your and other players' ranking statistics, along with other important information on Toribash Ranking and current seasons. Check it out!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6036085/0c8d7939b13b9d81113b629eb77681f641db21a7.png[/img]


[b]Learn more about Toribash Season 5 on forums: http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=620288[/b]

notes.title: Toribash 5.3!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hi! Toribash 5.3 is here![/b]
This version contains huge UI updates and lots of other changes.[/h1]


[h1][b]New UI[/b][/h1]

Toribash main menu has been recreated from scratch and all the (previously) text-only buttons now have nice visuals with outstanding artwork from your boy [url=http://forum.toribash.com/member.php?u=177807]Hagan[/url]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6036085/4054af76e0f4e13ce1c45cf839c17fbc65c22eeb.png[/img]
This is what you'll see when launching Toribash 5.3. Play tab has quick access to Single Player mode, Matchmaking (which has been also updated and shows additional helpful info) and Multiplayer Room List.
You can also see your account main info in top right corner - your head avatar, belt, clan, TC and ST data will be always displayed there while you are browsing new Toribash menus. You can also switch accounts quicker now by pressing Login button displayed next to your current account's name.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6036085/b0496b50be752e8b45e95e8926d0f07b6f605e05.png[/img]
Home page shows announcements about Toribash events and new releases, current Torishop daily sale and quick access to Clans and your saved replays.


Training, Mods and Tools section contain tutorials, mod-related stuff and miscellaneous menus respectively.


[h1][b]Clans 2.0[/b][/h1]

We have continued our work on ingame clans UI and it's now available any time from main menu. Here's what you see when pressing on that nice "Clans" button from Home tab:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6036085/84aac4a51ec7110ba43d34f5d125db1ee4e0d503.png[/img]

Clans Home is now split into two sections with an already familiar clan list on the right and your clan status on the left. You can now see your clan status, up to two random clan mates of same status (leader / member) and a button to view your clan. Clan list has also been upgraded and now features proper filtering for you to find specific clans faster.


[h1][b]Ingame Inventory[/b][/h1]
(Whaaaaaaat, we've been asking for that like forever???!?!!)

[b]Woo, inventory is here![/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6036085/93b96bdc39358d4805b6a0db867c56ad508b1fc0.png[/img]

You can now view your items, unpack, activate and deactivate them right from the game client! We'll keep working on inventory in future releases to allow full set manipulation functionality and some other neat stuff like market, so stay tuned!


[h1][b]Comeback Practice[/b][/h1]

Comeback Practice is a new mode you can play in Training section. You need to hit Uke as many times as you can - but he will keep teleporting away from you every time you touch him. Teleport distance increases with each time, too, so it's getting gradually harder to catch him after each hit!

There are three toggleable settings for you to adapt conditions to your favorite play style: turnframes, gravity and match frames. Frame-by-frame skipping is allowed, too - just in case you want to play for the sake of making a replay and don't want to keep those previous frames unused.


[h1][b]Other updates[/b][/h1]


[list][*]New languages: new UI has full English, French, Portuguese, Spanish and Russian translation
[*]Changed tori and uke camera view to first person
[*]Fixed a bug that made joints disappear when a player has custom obj joints with 3D items display disabled
[*]Added rotateable gravity option for flames
[*]Added persistent world shader configuration
[*]Fixed ground not changing on new player
[*]Mod-specific motd now also sets custom motd in MP rooms
[/list]

[b]Nerd stuff:[/b]
[list][*]Added full utf8 support to lua get_string_length() function
[*]Added get_language() function for lua
[*]Increased max number of texture load support from 128 to 256
[*]Added bigger size toribash font (id 9)
[*]Added configurable memory size consumption for matchframe and replay cache
(0 = 1024, 1 = 4096, 2 = 8192, above 1024 will be rounded up to next power of two)[/list]


[h1][b]Last but not least[/b][/h1]

Windows version of Toribash now has full Discord Rich Presence support!
Discord now would show your Toribash name, belt, season ranking and a cool "Ask to Join" button for your friends to come play with you even easier!

notes.content:

[list][*][h1][b]Beginner Clans[/b][/h1]
You could have noticed two new official clans called [b]Blue[/b] and [b]Red[/b] but never seen or heard of them before.

notes.content:

notes.title: Toribash 5.2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Toribash 5.2 is finally out![/b][/h1]

[b]Check out what's new:[/b]

[list][*][b]Daily login rewards[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6036085/d23546e67158077ef5eb82fc5a3d71cb1ebd413f.png[/img]

Logging in Toribash every day now gives you free TC!
Play Toribash every day for a week and earn 2100 TC and a Shiai Token that you can spend on neat and fancy items!

Note: you can only claim your reward for one account every day.


[*][b]Updated player queue dropdown menu[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6036085/373476d1c881739f79f8ea6816bbd8bb5d58f6bf.png[/img]

Old one got cluttered with unnecessary commands, now the menu would only display commands that you can execute. It definitely looks cleaner now with less than 10 commands by default, doesn't it?


[*][b]Clans[/b]
As you may have noticed in the screenshot above, you're now able to view players' clan info. Let's take a look at the ingame clan UI:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6036085/5de47913adba3e68d710b2b1df4bc5b1e7d75352.png[/img]
This is a clan page. Clan rank, its level and XP, logo and top achievement - all the essential info can now be accessible right from the game client. For clans that are free for all you'll even see a "Join clan" button that would instantly add you to that clan!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6036085/8f137afa41255b824ac64127f7839491f289c685.png[/img]
Clan Roster. A way to quickly view all clan members and leaders and easily contact them - clicking on any user's name would bring you to their profile on forum.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6036085/8667c8658447725930bd127df1294d591cbcb7b2.png[/img]
Clan list. In case you're looking for a clan to join or just feeling like checking some other clan, navigate to clan list by pressing the "Back" button on top left when viewing any clan. Clan list also provides quick access to your own clan - just press the button on bottom to view it.


[*][b]Christmas time![/b]

We've added some fancy christmas mods in all belt-restricted rooms! It's snowing there!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6036085/0c83f78cb446e7349b9c72234f7fee11c4553fd6.png[/img]


[*][b]+ Some bugfixes and other minor stuff[/b][/list]

notes.title: Toribash Season 2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Greetings!
Season 2 is coming to Toribash![/b][/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/M3danIZ.png[/img]


[h1][b]Season 2 updates[/b][/h1]

[b]There are two main changes we've prepared for this season: ranking tiers and forum ranking UI. Let's take a closer look at what's been changed:[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Qaq0sio.png[/img]

Raw ELO system we used during Season 1 has been replaced with Ranking Tiers. As you can see on the image above, there are 5 tiers: 

[list][*]Elo Hell
[*]Bronze Tier
[*]Silver Tier
[*]Gold Tier
[*]Platinum Tier[/list]


Ranking Tiers are displayed both in-game and on forum Ranking page. Top players who get to Gold or Platinum will also get their global ranking position displayed in addition to their tier.

In order to get a rank tier during Season 2, any player has to complete 10 qualification fights in ranked mode first. When the first 10 games are over you will get your primary rank tier - which can be Bronze, Silver or Gold depending on qualification fights' outcome. After that you can move up (or down) rank tiers by keeping playing in ranked mode. You will see chat notifications when approaching your next rank tier, and you will see an additional notification when you're about to play a qualification fight.


[b]Read about forum ranking UI update in Season 2 announcement thread: http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?p=9196355[/b]



[h1][b]Rewards[/b][/h1]


[b]Season 2's top players will receive the following prizes:[/b]

[list][*][b]Rank 1:[/b] 500K TC, Void+Superior Pack, unique 3D item set.
[*][b]Rank 2:[/b] 400K TC, Demon+Demolition Pack, limited edition 3D item set.
[*][b]Rank 3:[/b] 300K TC, Pure+Elf Pack, limited edition 3D item set.
[*][b]Platinum Tier:[/b] Random Tier X Pack, limited edition 3D item set.
[*][b]Gold Tier:[/b] limited edition 3D item.[/list]



[b]Season 2 end date is November 18th, 2017.[/b]
We have also added 50 TC boosters to Matchmaking that expire next Sunday.

Ranking Tiers are displayed both in-game and on forum Ranking page. Top players who get to Gold or Platinum will also get their global ranking position displayed in addition to their tier.

In order to get a rank tier during Season 2, any player has to complete 10 qualification fights in ranked mode first. When the first 10 games are over you will get your primary rank tier - which can be Bronze, Silver or Gold depending on qualification fights' outcome. After that you can move up (or down) rank tiers by keeping playing in ranked mode. You will see chat notifications when approaching your next rank tier, and you will see an additional notification when you're about to play a qualification fight.


[b]Read about forum ranking UI update in Season 2 announcement thread: http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?p=9196355[/b]



[h1][b]Rewards[/b][/h1]


[b]Season 2's top players will receive the following prizes:[/b]

[list][*][b]Rank 1:[/b] 500K TC, Void+Superior Pack, unique 3D item set.
[*][b]Rank 2:[/b] 400K TC, Demon+Demolition Pack, limited edition 3D item set.
[*][b]Rank 3:[/b] 300K TC, Pure+Elf Pack, limited edition 3D item set.
[*][b]Platinum Tier:[/b] Random Tier X Pack, limited edition 3D item set.
[*][b]Gold Tier:[/b] limited edition 3D item.[/list]



[b]Season 2 end date is November 18th, 2017.[/b]
We have also added 50 TC boosters to Matchmaking that expire next Sunday.

notes.title: May Torishop Update and Lottery
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hi![/b][/h1]

[b]May Torishop update has just been pushed live and it has plenty of changes that (are supposed to) make shop navigation easier. Here's the new stuff:[/b]


[h1][b]Separation between single items and item packs[/b][/h1]

[img]https://puu.sh/vTS36/6aad5fb8bc.png[/img]

We have separated regular single items (colors, single textures, hairstyles, 3d models and misc stuff) from item packs that allow you to instantly customize your character. You don't have to wonder where to find Mecha Arms anymore, wow!

[h1][b]Intuitive sections[/b][/h1]

[img]https://puu.sh/vTSiB/bc168f6ab2.png[/img]

There's a total of 8 item sections which are split equally between Single Items and Item Packs, and they (kinda?) make sense! You won't find Hair Color items in Models section anymore, nor will you struggle finding preloaded Full Texture Sets.

[h1][b]ToriLottery is back[/b][/h1]

Hampa says lotteries are for the elderly. 
We like them nonetheless. This May, get a chance to win Cobra Pack by spending just 100 TC (or Demon Pack if you like playing big)!
Access the Beginner and Pro lotteries from Torishop or get tickets on forum: http://forum.toribash.com/tori_lottery.php

notes.title: Ranking Season One.
notes.content:
[img]https://puu.sh/vbCDC/e7399c8efd.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hello there![/b][/h1]
[b]Today we announce the new seasonal ranking system for Toribash.[/b]


[img]https://puu.sh/vbCSm/1ccb5a17d6.png[/img]

[h1][b]No more monthly rank resets.[/b][/h1]
The first season is going to last for 3 months and will end on June 30th, 2017. No resets until then, even if you stay inactive for a few weeks and then come back.

[h1][b]No more public ranked rooms.[/b][/h1]
We all know the old ranking was a farm fest with some of the top players only fighting their friends who would lose on purpose. This would no longer be possible. All the public ranked rooms have been removed.

[h1][b]No more daily rank 1 rewards.[/b][/h1]
You spend half the day playing, get rank 1 and already dream of buying that new 3D item but then you login the next day and know that some Russian stole your prize because he played a bit more when it was the right time. Sounds bad, right? That's why we have removed the daily rewards - instead, the best players will get their prizes when the season is over.

[h1][b]The new matchmaking.[/b][/h1]
With the new system, the only way to rank up is to use the ranked mode in Matchmaking. We have made some significant updates to it in Toribash 5.12 [url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=587185]thanks to your feedback.[/url]


[img]https://puu.sh/vbCZp/be772fbe42.png[/img]

[b]We tried our best to both reduce the waiting time and make sure players can't select their opponents - and that's the why ranked matchmaking is used for the new ranking. When it's peak time, you no longer have to wait in a queue; once there is someone else willing to play, you will be instantly put in a fight. More than two players searching at once? The system will pick a better opponent for you to fight based on your rank.[/b]

[h1][b]Brown belt restriction.[/b][/h1]
Sorry beginners, but ranked fights are for those who can stay on their feet for more than 50 frames. 

[h1][b]Automatic mod choice.[/b][/h1]
Unlike unranked matchmaking, you cannot choose what mods to play with ranked. If you aim for the top, you've got to be the best at everything, be it aikido or wushu. Ranked matchmaking is using 3 mods from different mod groups, and we will rotate them each month. April mods are as classic as they can be: aikidobigdojo.tbm, lenshu3ng.tbm and taekkyon.tbm.

[h1][b]Best of 5 duels.[/b][/h1]
To ensure the matchmaking session isn't luck-based, ranked fights are first-to-three duels. Accidentally lost an arm in a kicking mod and grappling mods aren't your strongest side? You still have a striking mod left which can give you a second chance at kicking.




[img]https://puu.sh/vbDf5/e19ca4a2c7.png[/img]

[b]Top 100 players will be rewarded at the end of the season.[/b]

[h1][b]Rank #1:[/b][/h1] [b]500.000 Toricredits, Pure + Demon Pack, unique 3D item.[/b]

[h1][b]Rank #2:[/b][/h1] [b]400.000 Toricredits, Magma + Azurite Pack, limited edition 3D item.[/b]

[h1][b]Rank #3:[/b][/h1] [b]300.000 Toricredits, Tesla + Boreal Pack, limited edition 3D item.[/b]

[h1][b]Ranks #4-10:[/b][/h1] [b]100.000 Toricredits, limited edition 3D item.[/b]

[h1][b]Ranks #11-100:[/b][/h1] [b]limited edition 3D item.[/b]


Rank #1 and season one limited edition 3D items are to be announced.




[h1][b]And one last thing: we've put 50 TC boosters for all matchmaking rooms which will last until April, 10th! Time to play![/b][/h1]

notes.title: [ES]What type of tourney should we host more?
notes.content:
Hello friends. The ES have decided to find out what kind of mods you want us to host more often. We host a variety of mods, some more 'competitive' than others. We want to know which type of mod you prefer in our in-game events. (i.e. tourneys, hotseats, victories).
[URL=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=558603]You can vote here on this poll.[/URL]

I'll split the mods into 3 categories down below and include examples so you can read up about it before you make a decision. 


[h1]Examples of mods [I]which could be[/I] considered 'competitive':[/h1]
[list]
[*]ABD
[*]Lenshu3ng
[*]erthtkv2
[*]greykido
[*]rkmma
[/list]

[h1]Examples of mods [I]which could be[/I] considered 'semi-competitive':[/h1]
[list]
[*]TK 
[*]aikido
[*]boxshu_mushu_v3
[*]judofrac
[*]gtspikes
[*]Odlov's weapon mods
[/list]

[h1]Examples of mods [I]which could be[/I] considered 'non-competitive':[/h1]
[list]
[*]Jousting
[*]Judo
[*]Acrojoust
[*]Pendulumjumper
[/list]

Please give us your honest opinions. If this proves useful, then perhaps we could do more of these in the future. Let's also please not let this thread become a roaring debating over which mods are competitive and which aren't. This isn't the place for that, and every host will have their own idea, so let's save that for another time. [B]You know what we mean, don't be that guy. [/B] Please choose the option that [I][B]best[/B][/I] describes you and feel free to leave other thoughts and comments here along with your vote. 


[URL=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=558603]Make your votes known here on this poll. :)[/URL]

Poll has been closed, but feel free to post and discuss on here too.

notes.title: Halloween Festivities 2015!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/DojZ5xk.png[/img]

[h1][b]HERE WE GO AGAIN!

Oh yes, my spooky friends and bloody comrades! Halloween has come to Toribash once again!


[img]http://i.imgur.com/Nq1qg.png[/img]

Come closer, you silly little boy, you naughty little girl, we have both tricks and treats for you! Following events will happen during this year's festivities:

[list][*][i]The Possessed Item[/i] - event about creating your own halloween item - [url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?p=8323923#post8323923]already started![/url]

[*][i]The Haunted Gauntlet[/i] - revamped version of an event from last year, that is dueling in-game event for players with a chance to win a Demon Force - [url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=533390]already started![/url]

[*][i]Apparition Appropriation[/i] - do you remember Too Spooky!? Yes? Good, it's something similar. No? Be prepared for a treasure hunt type of event on forums, then - coming out on 10th October! - [url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?p=8331639]already started![/url]

[*][i]Art in Your Blood[/i] - clan event about doing replays and making art at the same time - coming out on 15th October!

[*]In-game [i]Don't look behind![/i] events - don't let the spooky GMs catch you, watch out for broadcasts!
[/list]



[img]http://i.imgur.com/I9fAt.png[/img]

Of course, we have something special for you, as always! Old good Halloween special items from 2014 are coming back and new ones are on their way! Keep an eye on updates in [url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=533334]Halloween Festivities[/url] thread on forum to grab them![/b][/h1]

notes.title: Gamemasters Need Mod Makers!
notes.content:
[img]http://puu.sh/iHBbe/384a23731c.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hello Toribash community!

GMs, as you know, are here to make your experience more enjoyable with fun events. Whether they be make a piece of art, or tear someone limb from limb. Toribash is really varied, and mods are one area that are often neglected. This time they plan to change that.

Do you have loads of cool mod ideas? Can you make mods? Know how to do toribash lua magics?

If you're answering yes to any of these then you should apply to be a mod maker!



[url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=519751]See the official recruitment thread on Toribash forums for more details![/url][/b][/h1]
