notes.title: Item Forgers recruitment!
notes.content:
[img]http://puu.sh/hFIsT/c42895ea35.png[/img]

[h1][b]Ever wanted to create your own items for a game you play?
Then it's you time to get such a chance![/b]


Item Forgers are a staff group that specializes in creating new colors, 3D objects, hairs and any other items available in Toribash.
And they are currently in search for people who follow the requirements below:
[list][*]Activity - this is an obvious requirement. If you plan to apply, make sure you have enough free time.
[*]Clean Background - we need to be able to trust you.
[*]Modelling and/or Texturing Experience - this is the most important aspect. All forgers are required to be able to create some sort of content, whether it be texturing or 3D modelling.[/list]


[b]In order to apply to Item Forgers, please send an application [u]including examples of your previous works (either 3D modelling or texturing)[/u] to [url=http://forum.toribash.com/private.php?do=newpm&u=2488335]jusmi[/url].
All applications without them will be ignored.[/b][/h1]

notes.title: Seishin is available in Torishop!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello people, we've got some great news today!

As some of you may have heard in the recent days we've been testing a brand new subscription codenamed "Seishin" that is going to be released along with the 5.0 update.

Once activated, this subscription makes you feel stronger... literally!
Yeah, you become harder to dismember and your kicks and punches deal more damage!


Seishin is already available with the latest update in Torishop in the subscription section for a symbolic price of 1 TC - because we want you to try it out first!
Hurry up though, it will be only available with USD once the testing period is over.

Have fun and unleash the power of Seishin![/b][/h1]

[url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=506761]Click here for more information on Seishin on forum[/url]

[img]http://puu.sh/gWUdr/159d53c0e5.png[/img]

notes.title: Mod Showcase
notes.content:
[url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=495080]Original thread on forum[/url]
[img]http://puu.sh/e3LBP.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hello fellow Toribashians, today it's time to launch first edition of Mod Showcase by Gamemasters (special thanks to Scorpio for making this happen)!
It's going to be a quick review of interesting mods that were made within last 3 months, finished with replay challenge on one of them.

Out of the bunch of mods, we found 7 that stood out in some way, be it execution, originality or details, here they are:[/h1]

[list][*][url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=486979]Pinball Machine[/url] by [h1]MacSparrow[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/q04mrup.jpg[/img]
Interesting idea for a fun mod, pretty good execution.


[*][url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=491892]M.A.S training platform[/url] by [h1]Binklawz[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/E7wIAxm.png[/img]
Neatly prepared place to workout, what makes this mod a good one is the details of all objects.


[*][url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=485173]Alien Invasion[/url] by [h1]lolies[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/MeNE8kG.png[/img]
mod with a scenario, that gives it a specific touch, doesn't it?


[*][url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=491630]Unity Street[/url] by [h1]Matarika[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/6kXDwlX.png[/img]
Abundance of conveniently placed elements makes it good mod for tricking oriented parkour run.


[*][url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=488587]Berserk Clan mod[/url] by [h1]TRichard21[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/sbXkrU9.png[/img]
really climatic environment mod, right shaders make it even better.


[*][url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=487628]Mirrors Edge Parkour[/url] by [h1]Jisse[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/sc9jYEy.png[/img]
Pleasant for eye and well planned, does a good job imitating Mirror's edge maps


And the last but not least,


[*][url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=490939]Full Tilt[/url] by [h1]TRichard21[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/FkJmcB6.png[/img]
Brings new type of mods to the scene, hard to master but fun nontheless.[/list]


All authors of mentioned mods are rewarded with 5 Shiai Tokens




WANT TO GET SOMETHING TOO?


Now that we have mod showcase part done, it's time to play!
Subject of Challenge: Prepare the most stylish replay on Richard's mod tr_full_tilt.tbm found in the link above, the only thing you can change are the match frames.

1st place gets [img]http://cache.toribash.com/forum/torishop/images/items/magnetite_relax.png[/img] + 4 Shiai Tokens [img]http://cache.toribash.com/forum/torishop/images/items/token_2.png[/img]
2nd place gets [img]http://cache.toribash.com/forum/torishop/images/items/shaman_relax.png[/img] + 2 Shiai Tokens [img]http://cache.toribash.com/forum/torishop/images/items/token_2.png[/img]



Post your replays [url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=495080]in this thread on forum[/url] until January 25th and get that cool stuff listed above![/b][/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/sbXkrU9.png[/img]
really climatic environment mod, right shaders make it even better.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/sc9jYEy.png[/img]
Pleasant for eye and well planned, does a good job imitating Mirror's edge maps

[*][url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=490939]Full Tilt[/url] by [h1]TRichard21[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/FkJmcB6.png[/img]
Brings new type of mods to the scene, hard to master but fun nontheless.[/list]


All authors of mentioned mods are rewarded with 5 Shiai Tokens

Subject of Challenge: Prepare the most stylish replay on Richard's mod tr_full_tilt.tbm found in the link above, the only thing you can change are the match frames.

1st place gets [img]http://cache.toribash.com/forum/torishop/images/items/magnetite_relax.png[/img] + 4 Shiai Tokens [img]http://cache.toribash.com/forum/torishop/images/items/token_2.png[/img]

notes.title: Christmas Lottery!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey guys, it's Christmas Lottery time!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/OZAklLD.png[/img]

This year Marketsquad guys present you the most valuable prizes than ever before![/b]

There are three types of tickets that you can purchase to participate in the lottery:

[list][*][b]Cheap and Cheerful Tickets: 5,000 TC per ticket; 45,000 TC for 10 tickets[/b]
(Prizes include pure, void and demon joints, 1 month 100 TC boosters and more)

[*][b]Luxury Item Tickets: 10,000 TC per ticket; 90,000 TC for 10 tickets[/b]
(Prizes include 3D obj items, full pure, void and demon sets, 1 month 200 TC boosters and more)

[*][b]Mystery Tickets: 20,000 TC per ticket; no discounts[/b]
(Prizes are... mysterious!)[/list]



[b]To buy tickets, you have to send the TC to [u]santa[/u] with the message including the following information:[/b]

[i]Tiers:
Amounts:
User this is for:[/i]

(Third line is optional, don't include that if you're buying tickets for yourself).

[b]IMPORTANT NOTE: If you do not put it into the message when you send the money you will get Cheap and Cheerful tickets


Santa will stop accepting your payments for tickets on [u]December the 25th at 0:00 Standard Time[/u], so don't wait for too long!



[url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=491913]Check this thread for more information on the lottery![/url][/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/zQP3Vf1.png[/img]

notes.title: Toribash on IndieDB's Indie of the Year 2014 and 100,000,000 games!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hi people,[/b]

Let's start with an outstanding news that you may not have noticed if you don't visit game forums regularly - a 100,000,000th fight in Toribash was played. That is a truly great milestone in Toribash and we're thankful to all of our players. Turn on Toribash this weekend to celebrate that - we've got some big tourneys with big prizes for everyone!




And another thing (that is a bit less rare but still awesome enough) is that Toribash is taking part in IndieDB's Indie of the Year 2014 contest and we need your help! To move to the round 2 of IOTY 2014 Toribash has to get as many votes as possible - and that's where you can support us.

[b]To vote for Toribash, do the following:
1. Click [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/toribash]here[/url].
2. Press the awesome dark red button saying "Vote for this game". 
3. Go and spam all of your friends and relatives to vote for Toribash too.

(Third point is obligatory)[/b]



Thanks and have fun this weekend!
[/h1]

[img]http://puu.sh/dfMjp/bb91dc6351.png[/img]

notes.title: Halloween Festivities!
notes.content:
[url=http://forum.toribash.com/showthread.php?t=483071][img]http://i.imgur.com/DojZ5xk.png[/img]

[h1][b]Toribash's 2014 Halloween Festivities
LESS CANDY, MORE BASHING![/b][/h1][/url]

[b]As you walk down the street, you see people preparing for the big night. It's getting dark, the kids are putting on their makeup and making a few final adjustments on their costumes. An old lady opens her door and gently places a pumpkin on her doorsteps. You can feel it in you. It's the joyful vibe of Halloween. You rush towards your house and log on Toribash, an old habit. As you are carving your pumpkin, you notice the news: Halloween has come to Toribash![/b]



[img]http://i.imgur.com/Nq1qg.png[/img]

[h1][b]Take part in Halloween special events to get a chance to win unique 3D object items!

notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey guys, we've just made the latest version of Toribash public![/h1]

New in Toribash 4.9:[/b]
[list][*]Full Portuguese, French and Russian languages support
[*]Completely new Torishop
[*]Full Unicode chat support
[*]Folders in mods and replays
[*]Search option in mods
[*]Better camera in big mods (press 6 or 7 to zoom to Tori or Uke)
[*]No multiclient status for Steam users if they're on the same network[/list]


[i]* If you were using the beta version, switch to default one to get the update[/i]

notes.title: Torishop beta update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hi, we've uploaded a new build with the updated Torishop.[/h1][/b]

[b]New features:[/b]
[list][*]Main screen with the latest shop updates
[*]Easier section navigation
[*]Torishop shows if you have enough qi and TC to buy items
[*]General design changes[/list]

Purchase button for USD-only items is hidden for now, will be displayed with the new game client release.
Torishop uses some new functions from 4.9 so emotes will display incorrectly. Other stuff should work fine on 4.82. 


[b]To get the Torishop update in Steam, switch to the "-beta" branch in the "betas" tab in properties.[/b]
